query.statement: SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID AS VALUE, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT SPEC_ID AS VALUE, SPEC_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT SPEC_ID, SPEC_NAME, PROCESS_ID, ITEM_NAME, MEASURE_TYPE, NOMINAL_VALUE, TOLERANCE_PLUS, TOLERANCE_MINUS, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@measureType IS NULL OR MEASURE_TYPE = @measureType) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT PARAM_ID, PARAM_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, MEAN, UCL, LCL, USL, LSL, SAMPLE_SIZE, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPC_PARAM WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY PARAM_NAME

SELECT DEFECT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_COUNT, DEFECT_RATE, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_DEFECT WHERE (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, INSPECTION_TYPE, MEASURE_TYPE, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_ITEM WHERE (@inspectionType IS NULL OR INSPECTION_TYPE = @inspectionType) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

SELECT INSP_DEF_ID, INSP_DEF_NAME, PROCESS_ID, PRODUCT_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_DEF WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY INSP_DEF_NAME
SELECT METHOD_ID, METHOD_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, SAMPLING_TYPE, AQL_LEVEL, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INCOMING_INSP_METHOD WHERE (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY METHOD_NAME

INSERT INTO QMS_DEFECT_CLASS (DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE, IS_DELETED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@defectClassId, @defectClassName, @description, @severity, 1, 0, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
